name: @projexlight/sdk-registry
summary: Build-time scanner + runtime API for the SDK registry. Walks packages/* + services/* manifests, produces a normalized catalog JSON + bge-small embedding index, then serves loadRegistry / searchByIntent / findCompatibleSdks / getScaffold at runtime. The data layer the MCP servers + projex CLI consume.

hooks.name: scanWorkspace
hooks.description: Walk packages/* + services/* for sdk-capability.json files.

hooks.name: buildCatalog
hooks.description: Normalize scanned manifests into the canonical catalog shape.

hooks.name: loadRegistry
hooks.description: Runtime — load catalog + optional embeddings into a queryable Registry object.

hooks.name: searchByIntent
hooks.description: Cosine ANN search over scenario embeddings; falls back to substring when embeddings absent.

hooks.name: findCompatibleSdks
hooks.description: Walk the consume/produce graph to surface SDKs that compose naturally.

hooks.name: getScaffold
hooks.description: Generate a starter app tree from a list of SDKs (package.json + tsconfig + per-SDK integration stubs + tests).

scenarios.title: CI builds the catalog on every main commit
scenarios.when_to_use: Post-merge job — scanner walks the workspace, builds the catalog, computes the deterministic content hash, publishes the JSON + embedding bin.
scenarios.example_code:
$ node packages/sdk-registry/dist/cli.js --repo . --built-at '2026-05-26T00:00:00Z'
Wrote registry.catalog.json + registry.embeddings.bin
embeddings_hash=...
elapsed=5417ms
scenarios.expected_outcome: Catalog + embeddings written to dist/. Hosted MCP picks them up via its hot-reload watcher; no service restart.

scenarios.title: Cloud-builder agent searches the catalog
scenarios.when_to_use: Agent receives 'I need consent management for healthcare' — runs searchByIntent which embeds the query + returns top-k SDKs by cosine similarity.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Top 5 SDKs returned with score + reasoning excerpt. sdk-consent + sdk-evidence + sdk-data-rights surface for that query.

scenarios.title: Find SDKs that compose with sdk-evidence
scenarios.when_to_use: After installing sdk-evidence, suggest peers via the event consume/produce graph.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Compatible peers returned in order of edge weight. CLI shows them as install suggestions.

scenarios.title: Generate a starter app tree for a blueprint
scenarios.when_to_use: projex blueprint apply calls getScaffold(registry, sdkNames, appName) to produce { path, contents } tuples the CLI writes.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Tree includes package.json (deps pinned to versions in catalog), tsconfig, per-SDK integration stubs, vitest setup, README, CLAUDE.md.

scenarios.title: AC-2 deterministic catalog rebuild
scenarios.when_to_use: Run the build twice on the same source — catalog + embedding hashes match byte-for-byte. Required for the CI gate that audits cross-build reproducibility.
scenarios.example_code:
// run twice → manifest_hash + embeddings_hash identical.
// Stable sort + canonical JSON serialization in catalog.ts guarantees this.

compliance_posture.notes: Embedding index hash + manifest hash both deterministic — any change to the registry leaves a reproducible audit trail.
